sections.title: Checks the synthetic imagery fixtures
sections.what: Checks that the hero case returns two dated snapshots with the expected vegetation and built-up change values, that the control case returns its stable values, and that an unknown case returns nothing. It also confirms every snapshot is marked synthetic and not authoritative.
sections.why: Likely reason: the demo must show fixed, clearly labelled data so it never looks like real government imagery.
sections.watch_out: The expected numbers are copied from the fixture file, so a changed fixture value means updating this test too.
